## Key ideas {#fm1-finish .fm-slide }

A multiplier tells us the **proportion retained**.

Successive changes multiply their factors.

Reverse a percentage change by **dividing by its multiplier**.

::: {.takeaway}
I can choose and apply the correct multiplier to find an original or changed amount.
:::

<p class="small-note">No separate homework is allocated for this section.</p>

::: notes
Exit check: “A multiplier of 1.07 represents what change? What multiplier represents a 7% decrease?” Answers: 7% increase; 0.93. The booklet does not specify a separate homework allocation after Section 1.
:::
